events.text: A physician with a bamboo medicine box arrives in town. She treats the poor for free.

effects.log: She teaches you three herbs on the walk.
Needles, herbs, and a scolding. It helps.

events.text: Local apothecaries resent the free physician. Men gather outside her door at night.

ok.log: The men leave without a fight once they see you.

fail.log: A scuffle. She stitches you up herself.

effects.log: She leaves at dawn, grateful.

events.text: The physician asks for help in a village struck by fever.

effects.log: A hard week. Most live. You learn a great deal.
Blankets and rice. (−8 taels)

events.text: The physician has a formula that cures a common poison. An apothecary offers you silver to steal it.

effects.log: She thanks you with a copy of a lesser remedy.
Some trouble is not yours.

events.text: A man in the market sells 'the physician's miracle pills'. She has never met him.

effects.log: The crowd drives him out of town.
Flour and ginger. (−2 taels)

events.text: The physician confides that she was once a disciple of a poison sect.

effects.log: She trusts you completely now.
A story of a sister she could not save. You understand her.

events.text: A child has a badly broken arm. The physician needs someone strong to hold it straight.

effects.log: The child screams, then sleeps. The arm will heal straight.

choices.text: Distract the child with a story

effects.log: The child barely notices the setting.

events.text: The physician needs a rare herb that grows only above the cloud line.

ok.log: You bring back a basketful. She makes medicine for a hundred.

fail.log: You slip and come back with scrapes and a handful.

effects.log: He knows the paths. (−5 taels)

events.text: The physician lets you listen to your own heartbeat through a bamboo tube.

effects.log: Thump. Thump. You are alive. It is amazing.
She gives you a tiny herb pouch to start.

events.text: A cave where an ancient physician carved remedies into the walls.

effects.log: Old medicine, still good.
A healer's calm.

events.text: The physician moves on to the next town and asks if you will walk with her part of the way.

effects.log: She tells you the four signs of a failing heart. It will matter someday.

choices.text: Give her your best knife for the road

effects.log: She promises to use it only on herbs.

events.text: The physician takes your pulse and frowns: 'You are pushing your body too hard.'

effects.log: A lighter season. You feel ten years younger.
She sighs. Physicians are used to that.
